home_prompt: Create ui-mockup: a polished Japanese website proposal for noncurante ノンクランテ, self-roasted coffee and café in Hamamatsu. STRICT wide landscape 16:9 canvas 1536x864, not 3:2. Large desktop mockup left, narrow mobile right; show mobile photo then introduction stacked vertically with entire paragraph inside screen (no horizontal overflow). Elegant warm ivory and burgundy palette, thin rules, calm editorial typography. Header noncurante / ノンクランテ. Headline「珈琲と、気ままなひととき。」. Copy「浜松・富塚の自家焙煎豆とカフェ。珈琲の香りとともに、ゆっくりとお過ごしください。」. Nav「珈琲豆」「カフェ」「お問い合わせ」. Original still-life coffee cup and beans on wood, no fabricated actual shop interior. Cards「自家焙煎豆」「カフェのご案内」. Contact CTA「お問い合わせ」. Footer「非公式デザイン案｜写真はイメージです」. No fabricated prices, awards, booking or checkout. No address bar or invented URL. High-end restrained design, highly readable Japanese. This proposal specifically fixes hidden introduction on narrow mobile screens.
inquiry_prompt: Create SECOND distinct 16:9 landscape website mockup for noncurante ノンクランテ. Use referenced homepage only as visual identity reference, matching ivory/burgundy refined typography. Desktop contact page left and narrow mobile version right. Heading「お問い合わせ」. Intro「ご質問は、電話・FAX・メールで承ります。」 Contact cards with exact text「電話・FAX」「053-473-0848」「メール」「noncurante@nifty.com」. Secondary links「営業のご案内」「アクセス」. Mobile cards vertically stacked, all paragraphs wrap and email fits screen. Optional small original coffee cup still life with 「写真はイメージです」. Footer「非公式デザイン案｜写真はイメージです」. No web form, booking times, confirmation, prices, delivery claims or invented opening hours. No browser address bar or invented domains. Generous whitespace, readable Japanese and exact email, faithful page hierarchy. Main improvement is mobile-width contact information without horizontal overflow. Wide 16:9 output.
